title: Keisler Measures and Generically Stable Random Types
summary: We introduce the notions of $rgs$ and $irgs$ for Keisler measures, motivated by the study of generically stable random types and their associated Morley sequences. We obtain characterizations of these notions in terms of averages of classical first-order formulas over suitable probabilistic partitions (Theorems 3.2 and 3.3). We compare these notions with $fim$, $fam$, and self-averaging, and show that for types the notions $fim$, $irgs$, and $rgs$ coincide.
